## Lead Qualification & Scoring

### How it works

This workflow receives new lead submissions through a webhook, normalizes the submitted fields, and calculates a lead score from the lead attributes. It then creates a contact in HubSpot and checks whether the score qualifies the lead as hot. Based on that decision, it sends the appropriate email follow-up and can alert the sales team for high-priority leads.

### Setup steps

- Configure the webhook URL in the lead capture form or source system that will submit new leads.
- Set up the HubSpot credentials and confirm the contact fields map correctly to name, email, budget, urgency, and lead score data.
- Connect the Gmail credentials used for lead follow-up emails and internal sales alerts.
- Review the lead scoring code and the hot-lead threshold condition before activating the workflow.

### Customization

Adjust the scoring formula, threshold value, HubSpot field mappings, and the content or recipients of the Gmail messages to match your sales process.

## Receive and normalize lead

Captures incoming lead data from the webhook and standardizes the key fields needed for downstream scoring, including name, email, budget, and urgency.

## Score and create contact

Calculates the lead score, then creates or records the lead as a HubSpot contact using the enriched lead data.

## Check lead threshold

Evaluates the scored lead against the hot-lead qualification threshold and routes execution to the appropriate follow-up path.

## Send follow-up emails

Sends different Gmail messages for hot and cold leads, and alerts the sales team when a lead meets the hot-lead criteria.
